rationale: License-gated CodeQL is bound to its reviewed parser and platform expectation without claiming an executed scan.
The loopback OpenAPI target is intentionally non-exploitable; normalized output identity and parser-clean execution are required even when no template matches.
The locked dependency fixture is intentionally vulnerability-free; exact registry evidence and a normalized audit identity prove the clean result.
The documentation fixture is intentionally valid and must produce parser-clean normalized output.
The Go fixture is intentionally safe; the quality gate requires real execution evidence and exact stable/candidate comparison.
The minimal local Terraform fixture has no cloud resource misconfiguration; normalized output identity proves execution.
The JavaScript fixture is intentionally lint-clean under the pinned configuration.
The minimal JVM fixture is intentionally clean; parser-clean normalized output remains mandatory.
The ConfigMap fixture contains no workload security settings and is expected to be clean.
The typed PHP fixture is intentionally static-analysis clean.
The neutral polyglot fixture is expected to produce a valid empty normalized set under pinned local rules.
The Ruby fixture is intentionally behaviorally safe; real normalized output proves the reviewed clean expectation.
The Rust fixture may be clean under the pinned compiler lint set; normalized evidence and zero parse errors are required.
Syft emits an inventory artifact rather than vulnerability findings; the raw SPDX document is the evidence.
The canary is deliberately recognizable as fake and must not be treated as a production credential.
The safe source fixture may produce no security rule match; exact upstream execution and normalized output remain required.
The Swift fixture is intentionally lint-clean; exact upstream execution and normalized output remain required.
The SQL fixture is intentionally valid for the pinned dialect and configuration.
The deterministic local Git repository has no remote API identity; a parser-clean local result is the reviewed expectation.
